title: AutoCAD Drafting and Design

program.section_heading: AutoCAD Drafting and Design - Certificate of Achievement (8-15 units)
outcomes: Demonstrate modeling techniques to create mechanical industry standard drawings.
Analyze and incorporate design intent into models as it applies to all elements of design throughout the drawing process.
Apply industry standard geometric dimension and tolerancing practices to mechanical drawings for documentation and manufacturing.

notes: The '(8-15 units)' in the headings is the award's unit-range category, not the program total; the requirements list prints 'Units: 9.0' and 'Total : 9.0', recorded as total_units.
